_comment: Single source of truth for /card and the generated vCard. The URL https://jpdcompleteelectrical.com.au/card is printed on physical business cards and must never change. Everything in this file can be edited freely - run `npm run build` (or `node scripts/generate-vcard.mjs`) afterwards to regenerate the .vcf.
